title: High idle RAM usage on LTSC dev laptop (8GB)
symptom: On an 8GB RAM machine used only for programming, many Automatic services consume RAM at idle (Intel bloat, SMB/file sharing, WIA, push notifications, telemetry).

affected.condition: Low-RAM developer laptop, no printer/scanner/Bluetooth peripherals, WiFi only

root_cause: Windows enables numerous Automatic services by default that are unnecessary for a coding-only profile (Intel Dynamic Tuning/HDCP/IPF telemetry, LanmanServer SMB sharing, StiSvc WIA scanners, WpnService push notifications, dmwappushsvc telemetry, whesvc customer-experience telemetry).
diagnosis: Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.StartMode -eq 'Auto' -and $_.State -eq 'Running' } | Select-Object Name, DisplayName
detection: $true  # profile-based; review the target list before applying
plain_language: Windows arranca muchos servicios 'por si acaso' (telemetría de Intel, compartir archivos en red, escáneres, notificaciones). En un equipo de 8 GB usado solo para programar, eso desperdicia memoria. El script los desactiva y guarda un respaldo para poder revertirlos. No afecta lo esencial (antivirus, red, audio, tu PostgreSQL).
undo: Re-enable each service via Set-Service -StartupType Automatic and Start-Service, or restore from services_respaldo.csv / System Restore point.
author: @opencode-session
